summary: If your employer pays towards travel when you go on leave anywhere in India, part of it is not taxed: for each journey, the lesser of what you actually spent and the fare the rules allow for how you travelled, and only for a limited number of journeys in each block of calendar years. It is never more than the assistance you received.

routes.name: Travel on leave within India, paid for in part by your employer
routes.description: Each journey counts up to the lesser of what you spent and the fare the rules allow for its mode of travel.

disqualifiers.description: Not available in the default regime.
Journeys beyond the number the rules allow in a block of calendar years are not exempt, apart from one carried over from a block you did not use.
Travel for more than two surviving children is not covered, with exceptions for older children and multiple births.
